ruler.capA: A：{sym}。理论给出 {N} 位有效数字；界线“{cut}”之后诸位皆为{ghost}。虚线括号标示实测值自身的不确定度 {s}：自第 {k} 位起，它完全覆盖了剩余数值。比对能精细到哪一位，完全由实验精度决定，而非理论主观裁定。

ledger.h2: 拥有公开实验数据的十一项对照：最好与最差的一行同列一表。
ledger.intro: 以下十一项在当前均存在可供比对的公开实验观测数据；其余推论的完整目录载于专著主表。偏差衡量方式简明如下：1 σ 代表实验自身测定的一个标准误差，理论值偏离实测值几倍标准误差，即记为几个 σ。偏差最小的是弱混合角 sin²θ_W（不足 0.01 σ）；吻合位数最多的是 μ 子—电子质量比 m_μ/m_e（实验分辨的前 8 位完全相同，偏差 0.002 σ）。最差的一行是宇宙学重子声学振荡（BAO）标准尺的绝对长度：早期宇宙声波在星系分布中留下一把固定尺度标尺，该行对比其绝对尺度。在 13 个自由度上 χ² = 34.40，折合等效偏差 3.28 σ_eq。它与吻合最佳的两项如实同列于一表与同一刻度上，客观展示显著偏离的现状。13 个测量点联合计算的 χ² 与单行观测量的 pull 属于两种不同的统计量。
ledger.laneDiagnostic: 由 χ² 换算的等效偏差 σ_eq · 与 A 组 pull 属不同统计量
ledger.laneDiagnosticNote: 此两行均用于比对宇宙标准尺：早期宇宙声波在星系大尺度分布中留下特征尺标，DESI 在 13 个红移距离上进行了测定。第一行比对标尺的绝对长度，第二行仅比对距离尺度随红移的变化形状。形状一项偏差仅 0.44 σ_eq，符合良好；显著偏离的在于绝对尺度的整体大小。13 个距离联合计算一个总 χ² 并换算为等效 σ_eq，这与独立观测量的单点 pull 属不同统计口径，不可相互平均。
ledger.laneBounds: 单边上限：迄今仅得实验上限，尚无点值实测
ledger.laneBoundsNote: 理论给出的是具体单点预测值而非区间范围，且均落在现有实验上限之下。落于上限之下仅表示实验灵敏度尚未触及、条目尚未被检验，绝非已被证实。
ledger.legend: 标准化偏差 pull 是理论值与实测值之差，以实验自身的不确定度为单位衡量：相差一个误差棒即记为 1 σ。小于 1 σ 通常视为统计吻合；达到 3 σ 附近则须严肃排查或解释原因。两把尺子比对，精度仅能细至较粗的那一把；多数条目中，精度受限于实验测量。刻度分界线即标示实验分辨极限：界线之前的位数由现有实验分辨，可逐位核对；界线之后理论多写出的小数位，则相当于尚未兑现的检验支票，须待未来实验精度提升方能裁决或证伪。
ledger.exactNote: 精确有理分数，所有小数位皆已完全确定
ledger.noPullNote: 框架在这一行不承诺具体位数：理论导出的是强作用进入非微扰标度的特征能量线，而非 Z 玻色子能标处的小数读数——换算至后者须另行通过强相互作用标准 QCD 跑动程序计算。此次精度受限的是理论近似一方，因此本站如实不标注 pull；手稿原文曾记为 ≈ 0 σ，本页面采用更为严格的口径。此外，将色荷转化为夸克禁闭强力的动力学机制在框架内仍属独立构造（E5）。
ledger.censusNote: 专著完整清单包含 31 项主要推算、20 项配套读出、1 组稀有 B_s 介子衰变比对以及 1 条结构性宇宙学演化廓线 κ₄(r)。
ledger.censusAuthority: 每一项推算的最新详细状态均以专著手稿主表为准。
ledger.registryNote: “预言”仅沿用专著手稿对条目的原有章节命名；公开的预测登记表当前含 0 项预注册预测。以上全部 11 行均属回顾性对照。
ledger.measuredNote: 表内理论值与误差范围转录自 2026-07-08 冻结的公开评阅版。μ 子—电子质量比的实验测量数据已直接核对 NIST/CODATA 2022 官方基准表；其余十行暂未在此逐一展开独立实验溯源。理论端推导亦有待学界独立复现。
ledger.measuredSourceLabel: 核查 μ/e 数据来源与算术检验
ledger.noScore: 本表不计算任何综合总分，未来亦不计算。三类通道中的统计量本质不同，将其强行平均无异于把不同量纲的事物强行相加。
ledger.lambdaNote: 这一条目由两部分拼合而成：第一部分是几何响应量，等于 3π 除以宇宙视界熵（该熵由元胞晶格结构计数给出）；第二部分为指数尾修正项，取值等于 m_b/m_s 分数除以 64。同一整数 92,633 在框架内同时现身于三处（m_b/m_s 比值、精细结构常数电磁耦合修正在内的实验室读数，以及此指数尾项），作者称之为结构关联，而非由其一推导出另一项。本行亦立足于特定分支选择，并将普朗克质量保留作外定尺度单位而非理论计算值。此外，作者自身的勘误已明确指出：冻结版专著尚未将几何响应量 Λ_geo 与天文观测物理量 Λ_eff 清晰拆分。这里没有解决宇宙学常数问题。

ruler.sigmaSpan: error bar {s} covers every digit from {k} on
ruler.altA: Digit-by-digit comparison: the computed value of m_mu over m_e carries 15 significant digits; the measurement resolves the first 8, and all 8 agree. From the ninth digit on no experiment can yet check, and the measurement’s own error bar of plus or minus 0.0000046 covers that whole stretch.
ruler.altB: The same digit-by-digit comparison for lambda_C and sin squared theta_W on one shared digit axis; the cut falls after digit 3 and digit 4 respectively.
ruler.capA: A: {sym}. The framework computes {N} significant digits; the cut rule reads “{cut}”, and the digits past it are {ghost}. The dashed bracket marks the measurement’s own error bar, {s}: from digit {k} on it covers everything that is left to compare. How fine the comparison can be is set by the experiment, not by the theory.
ruler.capB: B: the same notation on two more rows, sharing one digit axis. The cut moves with the experiment, not with the theory. λ_C is {exact}. So it writes a digit at every position.
ruler.capCond: The computation on all three rows is a closed theorem in the manuscript. The condition sits in the next step: taking the cell’s two excitations to be the real electron and muon, and the fraction to be the Standard Model’s own parameter. That step the author himself lists as open (E8). sin²θ_W owes one more open step, the lift from the substrate into the weak force and electromagnetism (E3). So all three rows are read as conditional.
ruler.capSource: Values from ledger.json. The digit counts, the resolved-digit cut and the digit from which the error bar starts covering are recomputed at build time; if they disagree, the build fails.

ledger.h2: The eleven rows that can be checked against something public. The best row and the worst row are printed on the same table.
ledger.intro: These eleven are the rows with a public number to be checked against today; the rest of the census is in the manuscript tables. First, how the gaps are counted: one σ is one of the experiment’s own error bars, and a row is so many σ off when the computed value sits that many bars from the measured one. The smallest gap is on sin²θ_W, under 0.01 σ. The row that agrees over the most digits is the muon-to-electron mass ratio: all 8 digits the experiment resolves match, 0.002 σ off. The worst row is the absolute length of the cosmic standard ruler. Sound waves in the early universe left a ruler of fixed length in the distribution of galaxies, abbreviated BAO, and this row compares how long that ruler is. χ² = 34.40 on 13 degrees of freedom, 3.28 σ_eq. It is printed on the same table and the same scale as the best rows, far further from zero. A χ² over 13 points and a single row’s pull are two different kinds of number.
ledger.laneDiagnostic: σ-equivalents converted from a χ² · a different kind of number from a pull
ledger.laneDiagnosticNote: These two rows compare the cosmic standard ruler. Sound waves in the early universe left a ruler of fixed length in the distribution of galaxies, and DESI measured it at 13 distances. The first row compares the ruler’s absolute length, the second only its shape. The shape row comes in at 0.44 σ_eq and fits well; what is off is the whole length of the ruler. The 13 distances go into one χ², which is then converted to an equivalent σ; that is a different kind of number and does not average with the rows above.
ledger.laneBounds: One-sided: upper limits only, not yet measured
ledger.laneBoundsNote: Each is given as a single number rather than a range, and it sits below every current limit. Below a limit means untested, not confirmed.
ledger.legend: A pull is the gap between the computed value and the measured one, counted in the experiment’s own error bar: one error bar is 1 σ. Under 1 σ is ordinary agreement; around 3 σ has to be explained. Two rulers can only be compared down to the coarser one, and on most rows the coarser ruler is the experiment’s. The vertical rule marks where the experiment stops resolving. The digits to its left are the ones the experiment can resolve, and therefore check; the digits the theory writes to the right of it are a cheque it has signed, to be cashed — or bounced — the day the experiment’s ruler gets finer.
ledger.exactNote: an exact fraction — every digit is already fixed
ledger.noPullNote: The framework commits no digits on this row. What it hands over is a scale line: the line where the strong force becomes strong. The decimal at the Z-boson mass follows only after the strong force’s own standard calculation, QCD running. Here the coarser ruler is the theory’s, so this site prints no pull; the manuscript itself prints ≈ 0 σ, and the site chose the stricter reading. And the force that glues quarks together is still built separately in this theory (E5).
ledger.censusNote: The full census is 31 primary predictions, 20 companion readouts, 1 set of rows for rare B_s decays, and 1 structural cosmology profile, κ₄(r).
ledger.censusAuthority: The manuscript tables are the authority on each row’s current status.
ledger.registryNote: “Predictions” is the manuscript’s name for these entries; the public Registry currently contains 0 preregistered predictions. All 11 rows above are retrospective comparisons.
ledger.measuredNote: The table’s values and uncertainty bars are transcribed from the public-review edition frozen 2026-07-08. The measured muon-to-electron mass ratio has been cross-checked against the NIST/CODATA 2022 table; the other ten rows have not been independently sourced here. The theoretical calculation still awaits independent reproduction.
ledger.noScore: There is no total score, and there will not be one. The three lanes hold three different kinds of number; averaging them would add up three unlike things and call the result one number.
ledger.lambdaNote: This row is put together from two pieces. First: the geometric response quantity is 3π divided by the entropy of the cosmic horizon, an entropy counted from the cell’s structure. Second: the tail of the exponent is the m_b/m_s fraction divided by 64. The same 92,633 turns up in three places in this theory — the m_b/m_s row, the strength of the electromagnetic coupling, and that tail. The author calls this a structural agreement, not a derivation of one from the other. The row stands on a selected branch, with the Planck mass kept as a unit rather than derived; the author’s own erratum notes that the frozen edition has not yet separated the geometric response quantity from the physical Λ. The cosmological-constant problem is not solved here.
